title: Cookie Policy
description: How the Office of the Royal Society website uses cookies and browser storage

blocks.heading: Cookie Policy
blocks.lead: How the Office of the Royal Society website uses cookies and browser storage

blocks.heading: At a glance
blocks.lead: Cookies and browser storage (Local Storage) are small pieces of data a website saves on your device to remember your settings and make the site easier to use.

items.title: No tracking, no ads
items.body: This website does not use cookies to track your behaviour or show advertising.

items.title: Only your settings
items.body: Only your chosen language, text size and display options are saved.

items.title: You are in control
items.body: Change your choice or clear stored data at any time on this page.

blocks.heading: Data this website stores in your browser
rows: Remembers your text size and accessibility tools
Remembers your answer to the cookie notice
Remembers your last 5 searches (only if you accept all)
Shows the accessibility tools tip only once

blocks.heading: Content from third-party providers
paragraphs: Some pages include YouTube videos, a Google Calendar and links to Facebook. These providers may set their own cookies when you play or open their content, under their own policies.
Videos on this website play through youtube-nocookie.com, which does not set cookies until you press play.
